# HostIP <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
HostIP:Int32 host_index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host_index` | In | Int32 | required | The address to take, counting from 1. |

**Returns:** One of the addresses found by the last [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs), as a number for [DottedIP](DottedIP).

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Without a call of [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs) the addresses of this computer are used. Only IPv4 addresses are returned (use [GetHostAddress](GetHostAddress) for IPv6 too), and an index past the last one returns 0.
